parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left door of the cabinet made of laminated particle board, forming one of the two front panels.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space when opened and provides a closed appearance when shut.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about vertical hinges attached to the cabinet frame.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right door of the cabinet made of laminated particle board, forming the other front panel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the cabinet’s right-side storage area and closes to protect contents.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about vertical hinges attached to the cabinet frame.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet, made of laminated particle board, supporting all other parts.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the doors and shelves.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving component that supports the entire cabinet structure.

parts.name: Shelf (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom shelf of the cabinet, made of laminated particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and helps distribute weight evenly across the cabinet base.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the middle shelf of the cabinet, made of laminated particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items at mid-level height within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but remains stationary during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Top)
parts.Basic_description: This is the top shelf of the cabinet, made of laminated particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an upper-level storage surface for lighter or less frequently accessed items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.
